name: cbws/php-cbws-grpc
description: Generated gRPC client libraries for CBWS

suggest.ext-grpc: For native gRPC; without it, the clients use gRPC-Web
suggest.ext-protobuf: For better performance, use the C implementation of Protobuf
suggest.google/protobuf: In case the C implementation of Protobuf is not suitable, use the PHP one
